name: monorepo-app-overrides-its-family
prompt: /test Ne lance rien : liste la commande de vérification que tu lancerais pour un changement dans apis/billing/src/Invoice.php.

pass: Dans `apis/billing`, `apis/billing/AGENTS.md` remplace la commande de `apis/` : je lancerais `make test-billing` (il démarre le stub du prestataire de paiement).
fail: Je lancerais `vendor/bin/phpunit tests/InvoiceTest.php`, la commande Changed de `apis/AGENTS.md`.

_doc: A monorepo with layered AGENTS.md: the family apis/ says vendor/bin/phpunit, the app apis/billing overrides it with make test-billing on its Extends line. Launched at the root, the agent must read the area's file and follow the app's rule, not the family's (ADR 0032).
